title: Bookella
lede: Bookella is a solo-built reading tracker and home library for iPhone, iPad and Android, aimed at reading more of the books you already own.

points: Books are added by catalogue search, curated lists, scanning a whole shelf of barcodes in one pass, or an AI suggestion.
A session timer, reading pace and yearly and daily goals track how much you actually read.
Notes and quotes can be saved with photos, and a page photo can be turned into text.
Libraries import from Goodreads, StoryGraph or CSV and Excel files, and sync across Apple and Android.
The maker asked whether it should also become a reader; commenters mostly said to stay a tracker.

sections.text: People with large physical book collections who want to log reading time and goals, or leave Goodreads or StoryGraph without losing their history.
Free to start with no ads, plus a Premium tier; the launch comment offers a free month of Premium.
